Privacy policy

This site is a static publication: it has no accounts, no comments and no forms, and it does not collect names or email addresses.

Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand which guides get read, so we can write more of the useful kind. Google Analytics uses cookies and records anonymous usage data such as pages visited, device type and approximate region. You can block cookies in your browser settings at any time.

Affiliate links

Links to Amazon are affiliate links. When you follow one, Amazon's own privacy policy governs what happens on their site, including any purchase you make.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page.
